description: Screen the whole Book (all reviewed tokens) and get compact ranked rows. Filters: tier, category, sector (a clean label such as Lending or Memes), flow_model (comma-separated for several), stale, query; numeric ranges via min/max objects, e.g. {"min": {"arr": 1000000}, "max": {"ps": 20}}. Fields: alerts, arr (annualized revenue, USD), arr_30d (ARR change over 30 days, %), arr_7d (ARR change over 7 days, %), category, conflicts, date, fdv, flow_model, holders_rev (annualized revenue to holders, USD), mcap, name, net_flow (holders revenue minus emissions, USD/yr), nf_yield (net flow / market cap, %), pct_unlocked, price, price_frozen_days, ps (market cap / annualized revenue), scorecard_age_days, sector (one clean sector beside the raw category, or null), stale, symbol, tier, unlock_30d (% of supply unlocking in the next 30 days). Default sort arr. Tokens with no value for a ranged field are excluded, never counted as zero.

query.description: Substring of slug, symbol or name.

name: tc_screen
